Fire Simulation and Rendering Authors: Eric Ge, Debbie Liang, Ziyao Zhang In this project, we achieved real-time simulation and rendering of fire effects in both 2D and 3D. Our implementation utilized the Unity engine and adopted popular techniques in noise generation, physical simulation, and volumetric rendering.
